                                                                653

 1                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   Read the 

 2   last section.

 3                THE SECRETARY:   Section 7.  This 

 4   act shall take effect on the first of November.

 5                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   Call the 

 6   roll.

 7                (The Secretary called the roll.)

 8                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   Senator 

 9   Montgomery to explain her vote.

10                SENATOR MONTGOMERY:   Yes, 

11   Mr. President, thank you.

12                I'm going to vote no on this 

13   legislation, and I wanted to just express the 

14   reason why.  

15                While I understand the seriousness 

16   of this drug, meth, and the consequences of 

17   people using it, we now are including possession 

18   as part of the criminal penal code.  And the 

19   problem with that is while we are now asking 

20   for -- in this budget the Governor has requested 

21   funding for treatment specifically around these 

22   kinds of drugs.  Possession implies that you are 

23   going to use it and that you actually would need 

24   treatment as opposed to it being criminalized and 

25   you going to prison.


                                                                654

 1                So I'm going to vote no on that, and 

 2   I hope that we will come to realize that while we 

 3   talk about treatment we can't at the same time 

 4   talk about incarcerating people who happen to be 

 5   actually ill using these drugs.

 6                I'm voting no, Mr. President.

 7                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   Senator 

 8   Montgomery to be recorded in the negative.

 9                Senator Krueger to explain her vote.

10                SENATOR KRUEGER:   Thank you, 

11   Mr. President.

12                I am also voting no because upon 

13   listening to my colleague Senator Montgomery, I 

14   so respect her raising the point that this bill 

15   would actually increase the penalties for someone 

16   who did not necessarily have the intent to sell 

17   but rather is a drug abuser himself or herself.  

18                And after so much success with 

19   repealing the Rockefeller Drug Laws just a few 

20   years ago, I would hope that this Legislature 

21   would move with great caution in reversing itself 

22   on any of those decisions.

23                So I vote no, Mr. President.

24                ACTING PRESIDENT GRIFFO:   Senator 

25   Krueger to be recorded in the negative.
